description: Defines a database change set class EncryptSecretAnswersChangeSet used for encrypting the secret answers in the users table during database migration.

classes.name: EncryptSecretAnswersChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change set class that encrypts user secret answers in the database during a migration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the encryption of secret answers for each user with a non-null secret_answer field.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating completion of the encryption process.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method, not used in this implementation.

methods.description: Sets the resource accessor, not used in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation before executing the change, returns null.
